question: After the validator is wired and exact-live-head proof passes, should release owners make schema-v6 ledger evidence mandatory for publication?
rationale: The mechanical integration can be repaired autonomously, but choosing the permanent publication evidence contract requires release-owner intent.

options.title: Wire and adopt schema v6
options.body: Integrate the validator into the canonical publication gate, prove the exact current head, and require the resulting artifact evidence for release.

options.title: Keep the existing process
options.body: Do not adopt the ledger workflow until release owners approve a different consumer and operator model.

recommendation.title: Wire and adopt schema v6
recommendation.body: Integrate the validator into the canonical publication gate, prove the exact current head, and require the resulting artifact evidence for release.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest recent merged history on immutable release evidence and the publication validation path.
